title: Chicken katsu
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts or thighs, pounded 1/2 inch thick
Oil for frying or cooking spray for air fryer
Tonkatsu sauce (store-bought or ketchup + Worcestershire + soy)
steps: Season chicken. Dredge in flour, egg, then panko, pressing crumbs on.
Shallow-fry in 1/2 inch oil until deep golden and 165°F, or air-fry at 400°F until crisp, turning once.
Rest 5 minutes. Slice and serve with rice, cabbage, and tonkatsu sauce.
